messages:
ana: @here Quick update — open enrollment policy changes and mandatory compliance trainings for Q2.

ana: TL;DR: clarified part-time parental leave (see summary). Mandatory trainings: Anti-harassment, Data handling basics. Managers need to confirm team completion by 2026-04-05.

ravi: Thanks. Is the parental leave clarification retroactive for people who took leave earlier this year?

ana: Not retroactive. It affects new leaves starting on or after 2026-04-01. Full text: https://tiny.redwood/hr/open-enrollment-2026

sarah: Managers — when you confirm completion please use the 'Confirm-completion' button in the training dashboard or run the export command below and DM the csv to people-ops.

sarah: ```/export-training-completions --org=redwood --period=Q2-2026 --format=csv```

training-bot: Assigned trainings to 128 users. Progress dashboard: https://redwood.app/training/progress (admins only)

maria: I'll coordinate with my ICs and get back by Friday. Any template message we should send to the team?

ana: Use this short template: "Please complete required trainings (Anti-harassment, Data handling) by Apr 5. Managers: confirm via dashboard." Copy/paste from https://tiny.redwood/hr/templates

ravi: done — pinged my team, will follow up Wed.

jordan: Note for record — updated handbook section 'Leave & Benefits' v2.1.1, changelog: https://tiny.redwood/hr/changelog. Filing for compliance audit.

maria: Completed confirmation: attached csv in DM to @sarah :thumbsup:

sarah: Got it, thanks! We'll run a final sweep on Apr 6 and escalate any missing completions to managers.

ana: Thanks all. If you hit any issues with training assignment, DM @people-ops or file an hr-ticket: https://redwood.support/hr
